title: Provisional English STT candidate shortlist
status: Exploratory shortlist only; no final model or two-model architecture selected
scope: English evidence only. Vietnamese requires separate data and screening.
decision_correction: Earlier Parakeet-live / Whisper-large-v3-final assignments were provisional. The available dataset and single whole-file run are insufficient for a final deployment decision.
provisional_live_accuracy_target: Corpus WER <= 15%; explicitly retain small.en and small as near-threshold comparison candidates, not accepted configurations.

live_candidates.label: parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v2
live_candidates.reason_for_retest: Strong preliminary speed/accuracy tradeoff; test actual live latency.

live_candidates.reason_for_retest: Nearby alternative; one run is insufficient to exclude it.

live_candidates.label: Qwen3-ASR-0.6B
live_candidates.reason_for_retest: Lower offline WER; check whether live latency remains acceptable.

live_candidates.label: small.en
live_candidates.reason_for_retest: Boundary candidate: WER 15.19% exceeds the provisional 15% threshold; not currently a passing configuration.

live_candidates.reason_for_retest: Boundary candidate: WER 15.43%; retain to compare the multilingual checkpoint, with Vietnamese evaluation still required.

final_candidates.label: Qwen3-ASR-0.6B

final_candidates.label: turbo [catalog]
final_candidates.reason_for_retest: Whisper-family speed/accuracy alternative; repeat with the target deployment.

next_tool_requirements: Treat model + backend + precision + decoder + hardware as a configuration; snapshot each run.
Evaluate actual live capture-to-caption P50/P95, time to first text, finalization delay, queue growth, transcript revisions and dropouts. Label fixed-chunk simulation separately.
For final transcripts, measure corpus WER/CER, sample failure coverage, technical terms, numbers, omissions and silence hallucinations.
Add more speakers, accents, recording conditions, noise, long sessions and interruptions; review references against audio. Record speaker and recording-session IDs.
Use speaker/session-separated development and held-out evaluation sets. Do not tune and declare a winner on the same 100 examples.
Repeat timing runs, separate loading from inference, record peak memory and variability. Where available use paired sample/speaker-aware uncertainty estimates for accuracy.
Evaluate English and Vietnamese separately; these English results do not establish language eligibility or quality for Vietnamese.
Compare one-model and two-model workflows; select two models only if the final quality gain justifies the extra cost.
Do not score failed model loading as bad recognition or zero error; retry environment failures separately.
status_note: Historical evidence only; recommendations are obsolete. Model selection is pending in Vangia ASR Lab.
